newsitem.title: USA: Coke to increase investment in Russia.
newsitem.headline: Coke to increase investment in Russia.

text.p: Coca-Cola Co said Monday it plans to invest an incremental $100 million in Russia by the end of 1997.
Coca-Cola said the move would increase its investment to $600 million.

The money will be used to build, upgrade and expand bottling and distribution operations throughout Russia. More than half has already been invested, and the remainder will be in place by the end of 1997, the company said.
Coca-Cola said it is now the leading soft-drink producer in 14 of the 15 former Soviet republics.
